Senior Software Engineer

Northgate Robotics
Cambridge, MA · Hybrid (3 days/week)

About Northgate Robotics

Northgate Robotics builds autonomous warehouse fulfillment robots for top-tier logistics customers. Our fleet operates in 47 facilities across North America, completing over 18 million picks per day.

The role

We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer to join the Fleet Orchestration team. You'll work on the planning and dispatch services that route work to over 12,000 active robots in real time.

What you'll do

  • Design and ship features in our Go-based dispatch service handling 60k req/sec
  • Improve our planning algorithms (graph search, ILP) for multi-agent path coordination
  • Partner with robotics engineers on protocol design across the cloud-to-robot link
  • Drive observability, performance, and reliability initiatives
  • Mentor 2-3 mid-level engineers

What we're looking for

  • 4+ years of professional software engineering experience
  • Production experience with Go, Rust, or C++ in performance-critical systems
  • Strong fundamentals in algorithms and data structures
  • Experience with PostgreSQL and Redis
  • Familiarity with AWS and Kubernetes
  • Experience with gRPC and Protocol Buffers
  • Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Robotics, or related field

Bonus points

  • Experience with multi-agent planning, MAPF algorithms, or ROS
  • Background in robotics, motion planning, or control systems
  • Open-source contributions

Compensation

$165,000 - $210,000 base + equity. Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, 401(k) match.

Work authorization

Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.
